routes.name: Residence and work permit in Greenland

note: Greenland, read on New to Denmark (nyidanmark.dk) on 2026-10-30. One offered employment in Greenland applies to the Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI), which decides on the Government of Greenland's approval: no fee; normally 3 months and up to 6 when more information is needed (6 kept); valid up to 2 years from the decision; for the job and employer stated only (work for the sponsor), revoked if the job is lost. Greenland and Denmark are two distinct travel areas: a Danish permit doesn't give the right to stay in Greenland, nor a Greenland permit in Denmark, so Greenland keeps its own routes rather than Denmark's. Citizens of Denmark (Greenland's own citizenship), Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden need neither a visa nor a permit to stay and work. Where the application is made isn't stated ('either' is the game's reading, SIRI taking it by its own channels), and permanent residence and its years aren't written.

sources.title: New to Denmark, Work in Greenland
sources.said: Normal processing time 3 months If further information is needed, the processing time can be up to 6 months ... Processing fee No fee ... If you wish to work in Greenland, you must apply for a residence and work permit at the Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI), which will process the application based on an approval from the Government of Greenland . ... Greenland and Denmark are two distinct travel areas. This means that a residence permit in Denmark does not give you the right to stay in Greenland. ... If you are a citizen of Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway or Sweden, you neither need a visa, nor a permit to stay and work in Greenland. ... A residence permit in Greenland can be granted with a validity of up to 2 years from the date a decision is made in your case.
